# HPC

## Question 1. Find the total for each row of a numeric matrix. Output should be a vector with length equal to the number of rows of the input matrix.

```{r}
# Total for each row
fun1 <- function(mat) {
  n <- nrow(mat)
  ans <- double(n) 
  for (i in 1:n) {
    ans[i] <- sum(mat[i, ])
  }
  ans
}

fun1alt <- function(mat) {
  rowSums(mat)
}
```

## Generate synthetic data (dat):

```{r}
# Use the functions with this data
set.seed(2315)
dat <- matrix(rnorm(200 * 100), nrow = 200)

# Verify if both are equal
all.equal(fun1(dat), fun1alt(dat))
```

```{r}
# Benchmark
library(microbenchmark)

bm1 <- microbenchmark(
  Original = fun1(dat),
  Vectorized = fun1alt(dat),
  times = 100
)

bm1

# Visualization 
library(ggplot2)

autoplot(bm1)
```

## Question 2. Calculate the running (cumulative) total along each row of a numeric matrix. Output should be a matrix with dimensions equal to the input matrix.

```{r}
# running cumulative sum by row
fun2 <- function(mat) {
  n <- nrow(mat)
  k <- ncol(mat)
  ans <- mat
  for (i in 1:n) {
    for (j in 2:k) {
      ans[i,j] <- mat[i, j] + ans[i, j - 1]
    }
  }
  ans
}

fun2alt <- function(mat) {
  t(apply(mat, 1, cumsum))
}
```

## Generate synthetic data (dat):

```{r}
# Use the functions with this data
set.seed(2315)
dat <- matrix(rnorm(200 * 100), nrow = 200)

# Verify both are similar
all.equal(fun2(dat), fun2alt(dat))
```

```{r}
# Benchmark 
bm2 <- microbenchmark(
  Original = fun2(dat),
  Vectorized = fun2alt(dat),
  times = 100
)

bm2

# Visualization 
autoplot(bm2)
```

## Question 3. Parallelize a process for computationally estimating the value of 𝜋.

```{r}
sim_pi <- function(n = 1000, i = NULL) {
  p <- matrix(runif(n*2), ncol = 2)
  mean(rowSums(p^2) < 1) * 4
}

# Here is an example of the run
set.seed(156)
sim_pi(1000) # 3.132
```

### Run this function multiple times and take the mean

```{r}
# This runs the simulation a 4,000 times, each with 10,000 points
set.seed(1231)
system.time({
  ans <- unlist(lapply(1:4000, sim_pi, n = 10000))
  print(mean(ans))
})

# YOUR CODE HERE
set.seed(1231)

seq_time <- system.time({
  ans_seq <- unlist(
    lapply(1:4000, sim_pi, n = 10000)
  )

  print(mean(ans_seq))
})
```

```{r}
# Parallel Version 
library(parallel)

cores <- detectCores() - 1


# Parallel Version
library(parallel)

cores <- detectCores() - 1

cl <- makeCluster(cores)

clusterExport(cl, "sim_pi")

clusterSetRNGStream(cl, iseed = 1231)

par_time <- system.time({

  ans_par <- unlist(
    parLapply(cl,
              X = 1:4000,
              fun = sim_pi,
              n = 10000)
  )

  print(mean(ans_par))

})

stopCluster(cl)
```

```{r}
# Compare pi estimates
pi_results <- data.frame(
  estimate = c(ans_seq, ans_par),
  method = c(
    rep("Sequential", length(ans_seq)),
    rep("Parallel", length(ans_par))
  )
)

# Comparison Boxplot
ggplot(pi_results,
       aes(x = method,
           y = estimate,
           fill = method)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Pi Estimates",
    x = "Method",
    y = "Estimated Pi"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Compare Runtime
runtime_df <- data.frame(
  Method = c("Sequential", "Parallel"),
  Seconds = c(seq_time["elapsed"],
              par_time["elapsed"])
)

# Comparison Boxplot
ggplot(runtime_df,
       aes(x = Method,
           y = Seconds,
           fill = Method)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Runtime Comparison",
    y = "Elapsed Time (seconds)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# SQL

### Setup a temporary database of movie data by running the following code chunk

```{r}
# install.packages(c("RSQLite", "DBI"))

library(RSQLite)
library(DBI)

# Initialize a temporary in memory database
con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), ":memory:")

# Download tables
film <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivanceras/sakila/master/csv-sakila-db/film.csv")
film_category <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivanceras/sakila/master/csv-sakila-db/film_category.csv")
category <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivanceras/sakila/master/csv-sakila-db/category.csv")

# Copy data.frames to database
dbWriteTable(con, "film", film)
dbWriteTable(con, "film_category", film_category)
dbWriteTable(con, "category", category)
```

## Question 4. How many movies are available in each rating category?

```{r}
dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "
  SELECT
      rating,
      COUNT(*) AS n_movies
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
  ORDER BY n_movies DESC
  "
)
```

## Question 5. What is the average replacement cost and rental rate for each rating category?

```{r}
dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "
  SELECT
      rating,
      AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
      AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
  "
)
```

## Question 6. Use table film_category together with film to find how many films there are with each category ID.

```{r}
dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "
  SELECT
      fc.category_id,
      COUNT(*) AS n_films
  FROM film_category fc
  INNER JOIN film f
      ON fc.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY fc.category_id
  ORDER BY n_films DESC
  "
)
```

## Question 7. Incorporate the category table into the answer to the previous question to find the name of the most popular category.

```{r}
dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "
  SELECT
      c.name,
      COUNT(*) AS n_films
  FROM film_category fc
  INNER JOIN category c
      ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
  GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
  ORDER BY n_films DESC
  "
)
```
